searchText: I am seeing a ~2x of missed blocks over the last few days <https://beaconcha.in/charts/blocks> Yep gone from ~85 a day to ~170 a day. cc <@388610194608750595> there's an ongoing investigation / exploration. looks like a combination of factors, some to do with the Capella CL nodes that more aggressively orphan late blocks, as well as possibly related to some relay changes. keeping an eye on them and will post an update soon are there hourly stats/charts around somewhere? not on our end
